mapper.sql: id, payment_id, order_item_id, counter_shift_id, amount, reason, refunded_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO refunds (payment_id, order_item_id, counter_shift_id, amount, reason, refunded_at) VALUES ( #{paymentId}, #{orderItemId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{counterShiftId}, #{amount}, #{reason}, #{refundedAt}DEFAULT )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM refunds ORDER BY id
mapper.update: UPDATE refunds SET payment_id = #{paymentId}, order_item_id = #{orderItemId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, counter_shift_id = #{counterShiftId}, amount = #{amount}, reason = #{reason} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT o.id AS order_id, o.pickup_code AS pickup_code, o.pickup_date AS pickup_date, o.customer_name AS customer_name, o.customer_phone AS customer_phone, oi.id AS item_id, p.name AS product_name, oi.quantity AS quantity, oi.quantity * oi.unit_price AS amount, oi.cancel_reason AS cancel_reason, oi.cancelled_at AS cancelled_at, pay.id AS payment_id, pay.method AS method FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN payments pay ON pay.order_id = o.id AND pay.status = 'COMPLETED' WHERE oi.status = 'CANCELLED' AND o.order_type = 'TAKEAWAY' AND oi.quantity * oi.unit_price > 0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM refunds r WHERE r.order_item_id = oi.id) ORDER BY oi.cancelled_at, oi.id
